# Reach a permitted list of hosts

`send.endpoint.allowed` — **send** × **network-endpoint** at **tenant** reach (the organisation's accounts, repositories and services). Family: network. Effect: **cannot be undone**.

## Granted by 1 of 9

| Profile | Control on the path | Evidence | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Claude Code — web container](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code-remote/ccr-container/index.md) | ○ boundary | observed | shell (Bash), fetch (WebFetch), harness (MCP and built-in tools) |

## What narrows it

**The setting:** shorten the list; a host it does not need is a host it can reach

**What it costs:** minutes per host, and a failure the first time it needs one you removed

**Tier after:** boundary

## Questions that ask about it

- *Does its outbound traffic go through a proxy or allow-list you did not set up?* — eliciting, reliability 0.3
